name: Coffee Machine Production Line Solution
summary: A complete automated line solution for coffee machine manufacturers, covering heating element assembly, water pump installation, circuit board assembly, housing assembly, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The coffee machine production line solution is a complete automated line solution provided by TXAM for small appliance manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers the full process including heating element assembly, water pump installation, circuit board assembly, pipe connection, housing assembly, and final inspection and packaging.

Solution Advantages

  • Precision assembly to ensure product quality
  • Automated functional testing to ensure safety
  • Multi-model flexible production
  • Efficient packaging system
  • Turnkey engineering service

Service Content

Provides full-process support including line planning, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, and after-sales service.
